name: Reitetsu Reisei Shikashite XXX!!
source:
Hyouma is a high school student. One day, Touko, his classmate who runs for the position of student council president and boldly declared "I will make this school my kingdom.", comes to his dormitory room and tells him that she is his fiancee. There is also a girl who stares at her. She is Sou, his bodyguard sent from his parents' home. "You can never become his fiancee...!" Like this, his new school life starts and he find himself sandwiched between the two parties racing for the student council presidency.

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090301140956/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1009340]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
冰马是一名高中生。一天，竞选学生会长、还大胆宣称“我要让这所学校成为我的王国”的同班同学冬子来到他的宿舍房间，声称自己是他的未婚妻。另有一名女孩始终盯着冬子，她是冰马老家派来的保镖奏。“你绝不可能成为他的未婚妻……！”就这样，冰马崭新的校园生活开始了，他也被夹在竞逐学生会长之位的两派之间。
